scenes.say: One crash, and the leader loses everything he built over half a race. How?
The safety car gathers everyone into a queue. No overtaking, and the gaps simply vanish.
Under a virtual safety car there is no car on track. Drivers follow a set time, and the gaps barely change.
A normal pit stop costs more than twenty seconds. When everyone else is slow, it costs a lot less.
At the restart the leader picks the moment to go, and the tyres have cooled down on the slow laps.
See who pitted under the safety car, live on LapRadar.

title: Safety car or virtual safety car: who gets lucky
